english.title: Possess an unlicensed rod and line with intent to use it for fishing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in a place, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), in which fishing for fish by a licensable means of fishing, namely rod and line, was regulated by a system of licensing, possessed a rod and line with intent to use it for that purpose when not entitled to do so by virtue of a fishing licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1)(b) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

english.notes: Paragraph 2 of Part II of Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 provides that any offence against this Act committed on the sea-coast or at sea beyond the ordinary jurisdiction of a court of summary jurisdiction shall be deemed to have been committed in any place abutting on that sea-coast or adjoining that sea, and may be tried and punished accordingly.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, in a place, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), in which fishing for fish by a licensable means of fishing, namely rod and line, was regulated by a system of licensing, the defendant possessed a rod and line with intent to use it for that purpose when not entitled to do so by virtue of a fishing licence.
